title: 第21章 该去要个交代了第22章 杀入县衙不说实话杀你全家
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【“奕哥？哎呀！
奕哥！
你也在这要饭吗？来，我给你挪个位子！”
【听到大春的声音，你鼻子一下子就酸了。
【这是你的真·老乡呀！
【大春身边还跟着一位姑娘，她一直躲在大春身后，一副很畏惧陌生人的样子。
【但是她看你的眼神怪怪的，好像在努力识别你是谁。
【“大春，这是怎么回事？你怎么不在悦来客栈，跑到马口镇来了？她又是谁？”
【大春的表达能力较弱。
【叽里咕噜说了半天，你听起来很费劲。
【倒是躲在她身后的姑娘，充当了他的传声筒，向你讲述了这些年她和大春的遭遇。
【你惊讶的得知，这姑娘竟然是你三姐的女儿！
【在你被充军后，没过多久，沈青山也中了圈套，被冤枉成杀人凶手，县令要砍他的头。
【结合你的遭遇，沈青山意识到，这是明晃晃的冤枉和栽赃。
【他不愿束手就擒，直接从县衙里杀了出来。
【在带着妻女逃跑的路上，沈青山遭到县衙、护龙司两个部门里的武者围堵，不幸战死。
【混乱中，三姐陈韵将女儿交到了正好出现在附近的大春手上，而她自己则引开了追兵。
【大春虽然脑子不太好，但是他知道县衙和护龙司都容不下三姐一家人，所以他毫不犹豫的带着小囡囡离开了白云县。
【二人相依为命，一路逃难，乞讨为生。
【你看着外甥女水灵灵的眼睛中，充满了对陌生人的恐惧，精致的五官因为营养不良而脱相，青春年华却一身污秽。
【你心中刺痛。
【不敢想象，她和大春这些年四处流浪，到底吃了多少苦头。
【能活到现在，真是个奇迹。
content_en:
["Brother Yi? Oops!
Brother Yi!
Are you begging for food here too? Come on, let me move a seat for you! "
[When you hear Dachun’s voice, your nose suddenly feels sore.
【This is your true fellow countryman!
[Dachun is accompanied by a girl. She has been hiding behind Dachun, looking very afraid of strangers.
[But she looks at you strangely, as if she is trying to identify who you are.
["Dachun, what's going on? Why weren't you at Yuelai Inn and came to Makou Town? Who is she?"
[Dachun’s expressive ability is weak.
[Jiligulu has been talking for a long time, but you sound very strenuous.
[On the contrary, the girl hiding behind her acted as his mouthpiece, telling you about her encounters with Dachun over the years.
[You are surprised to learn that this girl is actually your third sister’s daughter!
[After you were expelled from the army, it wasn’t long before Shen Qingshan fell into a trap and was wrongfully accused of being a murderer. The county magistrate wanted to chop off his head.
[Based on your experience, Shen Qingshan realized that this was an obvious injustice and frame-up.
[He did not want to be captured without mercy, so he was killed directly from the county government office.
[On the way to escape with his wife and daughter, Shen Qingshan was surrounded by warriors from the county government and the Dragon Protection Department, and unfortunately died in the battle.
[In the chaos, the third sister Chen Yun handed her daughter over to Dachun who happened to appear nearby, while she herself diverted the pursuers.
[Although Dachun was not very smart, he knew that neither the county government nor the Hulong Division could accommodate the third sister and her family, so he left Baiyun County with his little girl without hesitation.
[The two depended on each other, fleeing and begging for a living.
[You look at your niece's watery eyes, full of fear of strangers. Her delicate facial features are disfigured due to malnutrition, but your youth is full of filth.
[Your heart hurts.
[I can’t imagine how much suffering she and Dachun have suffered these years of wandering around.
[It’s really a miracle that I can survive to this day.
title_en: Chapter 21 It’s time to demand an explanation Chapter 22 If you don’t tell the truth to the county government, I will kill your whole family
